results.stdout:
usage: aidk [-h]
            {version,doctor,workspace,git,git-report,audit,dashboard,improve,fix,scan,db,deps,deps-db,deps-check,deps-lock,deps-licenses}
            ...

AI Development Kit

positional arguments:
  {version,doctor,workspace,git,git-report,audit,dashboard,improve,fix,scan,db,deps,deps-db,deps-check,deps-lock,deps-licenses}
    version             Show version
    doctor              Check installation
    workspace           Analyze workspace
    git                 Inspect git repository
    git-report          Generate git report
    audit               Engineering audit
    dashboard           Show workspace dashboard
    improve             Generate improvement plan
    fix                 Generate project fixes
    scan                Scan workspace and persist project data
    db                  Manage workspace database
    deps                Inspect project dependencies
    deps-db             Query stored dependency data
    deps-check          Check dependency health and reproducibility
    deps-lock           Check dependency lockfiles
    deps-licenses       Check dependency licenses

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
